question: Should OpenClaw permanently extend the shared Gateway `CommandEntry` contract with localized command descriptions, or keep command localization at owner-specific presentation boundaries?
rationale: This is a public cross-client protocol and plugin-facing contract choice; tests can verify an implementation but cannot determine whether the new field is the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Approve and define the protocol contract
options.body: Accept `descriptionLocalizations` as an additive Gateway field and require explicit client/channel compatibility coverage before landing.

options.title: Keep localization at presentation owners
options.body: Remove the shared command-schema field and have Control UI and channel owners resolve localized descriptions through their existing presentation paths.

options.title: Pause the cumulative series
options.body: Defer the localization rollout until the RFC or a maintainer decision defines the intended protocol and ownership boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep localization at presentation owners
recommendation.body: Remove the shared command-schema field and have Control UI and channel owners resolve localized descriptions through their existing presentation paths.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete protocol owner could not be established from the available current-main history.
